title: 1,289 datasets retired by an xx/xxx name prefix; the convention is undocumented
observation: retired by name prefix and/or category words (`obsolete`: 803, `notMaintained`: 441, current category: 45; 57 `obsolete` datasets carry no prefix). The convention is undocumented; consumers that match by name anchor on retired datasets unknowingly. BAFU explained by email on 12 October 2026 that these datasets should be avoided and will move to a "not maintained" category in its next release; community-fixes [patch 0003](https://github.com/sentier-dev/bafu-community-fixes/blob/053c799a4d3e129747f47d6775ea88647c0bec78/src/bafu_community_fixes/patches/p0003_flag_not_maintained.py) flags the prefixed ones (not the 57 without a prefix).

provider_response.public_summary: Explained that these datasets are old and of low quality, that users should avoid them, and that they will move to a 'not maintained' category in the next release.

validation_scope: Patch 0003 adds a maintenance extension attribute to the 1,289 datasets; names and categories unchanged. The 57 obsolete datasets without a prefix are not flagged.
next_action: Verify the 'not maintained' category in the next BAFU release; ask whether the 57 unprefixed obsolete datasets belong to it (sentier-importers' obsolete test already includes the category; patch 0003 does not).

retained.text: A `maintenance` column (obsolete / not_maintained / current) and a `retired_prefix` boolean in sentier-inventory, keeping both raw signals.
